summary: Mobile APK login fix verification complete - All auth flows working correctly on web. The mobile-specific fixes (fetch Proxy skip in Capacitor, safeParseJson direct json() first, CORS Capacitor origins) do not regress web behavior.
passed_tests: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials returns access_token, user, must_change_password (200)
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials returns 401 with 'Invalid email or password'
GET /api/auth/me with valid token returns user data (200)
POST /api/auth/refresh with valid token returns new access_token (200)
Login response structure verified for mobile APK compatibility
UI: Empty fields validation shows toast and stays on /login
UI: Invalid credentials shows error toast and stays on /login
UI: Valid credentials redirects to /dashboard with 'Welcome back!' toast
UI: Dashboard displays user name 'System Administrator'
UI: Session persistence - user stays on dashboard after 3 seconds (no race condition logout)
UI: Protected route /dashboard redirects to /login when not authenticated
critical_code_review_comments: index.js: fetch Proxy correctly skips in Capacitor via window.Capacitor?.isNativePlatform?.()
AuthContext.js: safeParseJson tries response.json() first (works in Capacitor), then falls back to clone+text
AuthContext.js: login function validates data.access_token before proceeding
LoginPage.js: handleSubmit validates data.user and data.access_token before navigating
LoginPage.js: setTimeout(100ms) ensures state flush before navigation
backend/.env: CORS_ORIGINS includes https://localhost, capacitor://localhost, http://localhost for mobile
